title: Delicious Beef Birria
description: A hearty and flavorful Mexican dish made with tender beef and a rich, spicy broth. Serve with fresh tortillas, lime wedges, and your favorite toppings.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the oregano, cumin, chili powder, and chipotle peppers to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth, tomatoes, and browned beef to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Braise the birria for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Shred the beef with two forks and return it to the pot.
Season the birria with salt and lime juice.
Serve the birria hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and lime wedges.
